acceptanceCriteria: Cargo metadata and lockfile report version 0.2.37 consistently.
Three-language release and architecture documentation identify v0.2.37 as the current release without rewriting historical release truth.
Release workflow and release policy checks pass from reviewed main.
Public v0.2.37 artifacts are downloaded from the immutable GitHub Release, checksum verified, and no source or workspace binary fallback is used.
Post-release adopter acceptance produces auditable acceptance.json and SHA256SUMS, proves runtime identity, repository isolation, lifecycle evidence, and temporary run-root cleanup.
The verified public v0.2.37 binary is installed and inspect, status, doctor, and agent doctor pass against this repository.
After merge and release acceptance, the repository has no unclosed Work Items, stale feature branches, or unmerged release PRs.
goal: Publish v0.2.37 from reviewed main, prove public artifact integrity and post-release adopter acceptance, install the verified binary, and leave the repository ready on base.
intent: Prepare and publish the next immutable AI Cockpit release after the merged release-adopter cleanup, then install the public artifact and verify it against this repository.
outOfScope: Runtime behavior changes and unrelated feature work
Historical archived Work Item records and failed unpublished v0.2.36 release truth
New adopter acceptance semantics or multi-technology matrix

scenarioCoverage.scenario: reviewed release preparation and immutable post-release adopter handoff
scenarioCoverage.expected: The reviewed v0.2.37 release route passes source and hosted checks, publishes immutable artifacts, and the downloaded binary passes isolated adopter acceptance and current-repository installation checks.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the declared documentation, version-consistency, workflow-policy, workspace, release, public-artifact checksum, adopter, upgrade, and installed-runtime checks after the reviewed merge.
